name: Mural parts
_about: the parts of tomb paintings in the hieroglyphs' language (glyphs.js): figure units (a square of the canon is 10), a head and its headdress at the neck's base facing left, a hand at its wrist along -x, a held thing at its grip

m-eye._about: the painted eye seen from the front in a profile face: the almond, the iris, the kohl line drawn out behind, the brow

m-head._about: a human head in profile on its neck: brow, nose, lips, chin, the jaw, the ear; the eye frontal

m-head-woman._about: a woman's head: the face finer, the lips fuller, an earring

m-wig-short._about: the short round wig over the skull, down to the nape, the ear left showing

m-wig-long._about: the long tripartite wig: a lappet falling before the shoulder, the mass behind to the shoulder blade

m-nemes._about: the king's NEMES: the striped headcloth over the brow, its lappets before the shoulders, its tail behind; the uraeus at the brow

m-uraeus._about: the rearing cobra at the brow

m-hedjet._about: the WHITE CROWN of Upper Egypt: tall, bulbous, a knob at its top

m-deshret._about: the RED CROWN of Lower Egypt: a flat cap with a tall back and the curling wire

m-pschent._about: the DOUBLE CROWN: the white within the red -- the Two Lands

m-khepresh._about: the BLUE CROWN (khepresh): helmet-shaped, studded with gold discs, the uraeus at the front

m-atef._about: the ATEF of Osiris: the white crown between two ostrich plumes, on ram's horns

m-plumes._about: Amun's crown: a low cap and two tall plumes, banded

m-sun-disc._about: the SUN DISC with the uraeus coiled round it (Ra, Sekhmet)

m-horns-disc._about: Hathor's (and Isis') COW HORNS cradling the sun disc

m-maat-feather._about: Maat's ostrich feather, on a fillet

m-vulture-cap._about: the queen's VULTURE headdress: the bird's wings down over the wig, its head at the brow, tall plumes

m-head-falcon._about: a FALCON's head: round, the hooked beak, the dark 'tear' marking below the eye

m-head-jackal._about: a JACKAL's head (Anubis): the long muzzle, the tall pointed ears

m-head-ibis._about: an IBIS's head (Thoth): small, the long beak curving down

m-head-ram._about: a RAM's head (Khnum): the long face, the horizontal twisted horns

m-head-lion._about: a LIONESS's head (Sekhmet): the blunt muzzle, the round ear, the ruff

m-beard-royal._about: the king's false beard: straight, its end squared

m-beard-god._about: a god's false beard: plaited, curling forward at its tip

m-collar._about: the BROAD COLLAR (wesekh): rows of beads round the neck over the shoulders and chest

m-hand-open._about: an open hand, the fingers together, the thumb up: at the wrist, along -x

m-fist._about: a closed fist, gripping: at the wrist, along -x (the grip at (-6, 0))

m-foot._about: a foot in profile seen from the inside (the big toe): the ankle at (0, 9), toes to -x

m-ankh._about: the ANKH, held by its loop (grip at the loop's top)

m-was-head._about: the WAS sceptre's head: an animal's (the Seth beast's) head bent forward

m-crook._about: the CROOK (heqa), held at the chest

m-flail._about: the FLAIL (nekhakha), held at the chest, its strands falling back

m-lotus._about: a LOTUS flower on its stem, held up

m-jar._about: a libation jar (hes), offered on the palm

m-throne._about: the BLOCK THRONE on its dais: a cube with a low back, the feather pattern on its side, the sema-tawy panel

m-offering-table._about: the OFFERING TABLE heaped high: a stand, loaves, vegetables, a duck, a lotus over all

m-kheker._about: one KHEKER of the frieze: a bundle of reeds knotted at its top
